item.title: One person as a creative team: what transfers from Dan Koe's letter
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: the part worth carrying away is the job split. It cuts the creative director role into brand strategy, content strategy, and writing plus ops. The price tags, the product plugs and the growth numbers belong to the sales side of the letter. Dan Koe published a long letter in November arguing that the most lucrative skill has always been capturing attention.
